summary: SciSparc Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release about its subsidiary NeuroThera Labs' collaboration with Clearmind Medicine. The release announces the U.S. publication of a patent application covering an MDMA and N-acylethanolamines combination for PTSD treatment, and notes finalized FDA guidance on psychedelic drug development. No special-situation transaction is involved; this is a routine business update regarding intellectual property and regulatory context.
